newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for just 3.0 bln lire of Italy CCT.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for just 3.0 bln lire of Italy CCT.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated just 3.0 billion lire worth of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion lire worth of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 7.291 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 1, 2004 paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.25 from 99.00 and gross yield at 7.05 against 7.01 percent at the previous CCT sale on May 29.
